thread:
maya: Heads up — found PII in a prefetch flow for search suggestions, looks like client-side prefetch is hitting our debug-capture path and getting sampled in. Anyone seen this before?
sam: oof. where's it captured? console inspect or ephemeral ledger?
maya: console inspect. path: /v1/prefetch/suggest -> routed to debug-capture when header X-Debug=1. We sample 1% and store ephemeral. saw email and phone fragments.
jon: question: is prefetch supposed to be scrubbed earlier? I thought client prefetches were minimal and should never hit inspect.
lucy: we currently only scrub on primary request flow. prefetch goes through mux and retains full body until sampler; scrub step is after sampling decision.
praveen: that's bad — sampling before scrub introduces leak. Proposal: move scrub earlier (pre-sampler), OR mark prefetch routes as auto-redact. tradeoffs: cost + false positives.
maya: @praveen yes. moving scrub earlier means more CPU and possibly more tokens to process. Also affects TTL and caching. Could we do fast hash-based token redaction as cheap filter?
sam: fast-hash approach: hash sensitive substrings and drop original. But embeddings leakage risk. We should pseudonymize rather than full drop.
jon: UX: Console needs to show which prefetches are auto-exempted from inspect and why. ops wants a toggle.
lucy: ops-bot: deploy-check: can we add new route flag prefetch:redact=early? ops-bot: :white_check_mark: created ticket #INFR-924
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled on canary cluster tomorrow 03:00 UTC. ETA 4h.
praveen: also need quota ripple: pre-scrub increases payload size if we pseudonymize? maybe not. We should document cost impact in Console per-route dashboard.
maya: ok next steps: 1) quick patch — mark prefetch routes as redact-before-sample (fast but coarse) 2) design doc for hash+pseudonymize and console flag 3) add telemetry metric sample_count/redacted_count per route. Anyone volunteer to shepherd?
sam: I'll do the patch + small perf test. ping me for canary.
lucy: :thumbsup: I'll add console flag mockups and an analytics card.
praveen: I'll write the doc and sketch workload impact. Will sync in standup.
thread_summary: Short thread about prefetch hitting debug capture path and leaking PII; propose redacting before sampling, add per-route console flag, telemetry, and a canary rollout.
